fields.description: Each company files under its own KRA account. Every field on this doctype belongs to this company alone — there is no shared/global DigiTax configuration.
fields.label: DigiTax Credentials

fields.description: This company's DigiTax API host, e.g. https://api.digitax.tech/ke/v2
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: This company's X-API-Key, sent on every request to DigiTax.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Last 4 characters of the stored key, so two companies sharing a key are visible at a glance.
fields.label: API Key Fingerprint

fields.description: Appended to this company's callback URL so DigiTax callbacks can be attributed to a company. Generated automatically when blank.
fields.label: Callback Token

fields.description: Invoices are only sent to DigiTax if this company's country matches this value.
fields.label: Target Country

fields.description: Timeout for API requests in seconds (default: 30)
fields.label: API Request Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed invoices (default: 5)
fields.label: Max Retry Attempts

fields.description: Max unsent invoices for this company retried in a single hourly sweep, oldest first (default: 100). At a typical ~5s per send, 100 invoices takes roughly 8 minutes; worst case (every invoice hitting the full API Request Timeout) it's bounded by that timeout x this number, shared across all companies within Background Job Timeout. A large backlog drains gradually over multiple hourly runs rather than one sweep trying to process everything at once.
fields.label: Retry Batch Size

fields.description: Timeout for background retry jobs in seconds (default: 600 = 10 minutes)
fields.label: Background Job Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Item registration for this company is manual by default: a Digitax Item must be created by a person, and an ERP Item's link to it is set by hand unless Auto Match Items by Name is on. St. Austin defaults: require Digitax Item Name ON, require manual sync ON, both auto settings below OFF.
fields.label: Item Sync Overrides

fields.description: When ON, every SI line Item must have Digitax Item Name; DigiTax receives that name only (never ERP item name).
fields.label: Require Digitax Item Name

fields.description: When ON, DigiTax send blocks unless the Item's linked Digitax Item is already synced (manual Sync to Digitax).
fields.label: Require Manual Item Sync

fields.description: When ON, a Digitax Item record (however it was created) is pushed to DigiTax automatically rather than requiring a manual Sync click. Not for St. Austin default.
fields.label: Auto Sync Items to Digitax

fields.description: When ON, ERP Items are auto-linked to a same-company Digitax Item by matching name, instead of requiring a person to set the link by hand. Governs linking only — a Digitax Item must still be created by a person first. Not for St. Austin default.
fields.label: Auto Match Items by Name

fields.description: Only users with this role can manually send a Sales Invoice to Digitax or view its Digitax/amendment status for this company.
fields.label: Send Role

fields.description: Only users with this role can manually sync a Digitax Item to this company's Digitax/KRA account.
fields.label: Item Sync Role

fields.description: Only users with this role can preview and send Digitax virtual amendments for this company.
fields.label: Virtual Amendment Role

fields.description: The account that automatic/background Digitax work (invoice submit, hourly retries, item auto-sync) always runs as, and that manual actions switch to once the initiating user's role above is confirmed - so every Digitax write is consistently attributed to one account rather than whichever user or background job happened to trigger it.
fields.label: Digitax Sync User

fields.description: Fallback item class code when not specified on item (default: 99020000)
fields.label: Default Item Class Code

fields.description: Fallback item type code for DigiTax item create (default: 3)
fields.label: Default Item Type Code

fields.description: Fallback tax type code when not specified on item (default: D)
fields.label: Default Item Tax Type Code

fields.description: Fallback origin nation code for DigiTax item create (default: KE)
fields.label: Default Origin Nation Code

fields.description: Fallback package unit code for DigiTax item create (default: NT)
fields.label: Default Package Unit Code

fields.description: Fallback quantity unit code for DigiTax item create (default: U)
fields.label: Default Quantity Unit Code

fields.description: Default item bar code used when a line has no matching Digitax Item (default: SCHOOL_FEES)
fields.label: Default Item Bar Code

fields.description: Whether the default item is stockable (default: No)
fields.label: Default Is Stockable

fields.description: Status code for submitted invoices (default: 02)
fields.label: Submitted Invoice Status Code

fields.description: Receipt type code for sales invoices (default: S)
fields.label: Default Receipt Type Code

fields.description: Status code for cancelled/draft invoices (default: 04)
fields.label: Cancelled Invoice Status Code

fields.description: Payment type code for invoices (default: 01 = Cash)
fields.label: Default Payment Type Code

fields.description: Used by the Sales Invoice(Digitax) print format. Leave blank to omit a field from the printout entirely.
fields.label: Print / Invoice Details

fields.description: Shown under the company name on the printed invoice, e.g. a motto or tagline.
fields.label: Print Tagline

fields.description: Free text shown in the NOTES box on the printed invoice.
fields.label: Print Notes
